02-mozilla.title: Mozilla: 85 languages, no sitemap.
02-mozilla.alt: Real run, worldwide card. Mozilla: 85 languages, no sitemap. Overall score 86 of 100. SEO 73, GEO 86, Analytics 85, Security 89, A11y 86, Speed 94. www.mozilla.org, 20 pages analyzed, 19 Oct 2026.
02-mozilla.linkedin:
Mozilla: 85 languages, no sitemap.

The home page lists 85 hreflang alternates, HSTS is on, and framing is denied. But robots.txt names no sitemap and /sitemap.xml answers 404, so crawlers find pages only by following links.

The lesson for every team: Publish a sitemap.xml of the pages you want found and name it in robots.txt with one Sitemap: line.

One automated analysis of public pages on 19 Oct 2026. A starting point, not a verdict.

es.linkedin:

La home lista 85 alternativas hreflang, HSTS está activo y el framing está denegado. Pero robots.txt no nombra ningún sitemap y /sitemap.xml responde 404, así que los rastreadores solo encuentran páginas siguiendo enlaces.

La lección para cualquier equipo: Publica un sitemap.xml de las páginas que quieres que encuentren y nómbralo en robots.txt con una línea Sitemap:.

12-aljazeera.linkedin:

Its JSON-LD names a NewsMediaOrganization and marks speakable text for voice assistants. Yet robots.txt disallows ChatGPT-User and PerplexityBot, which fetch pages to cite them in AI answers. GEO: 64.

The lesson for every team: Decide crawler by crawler. Training bots and answer bots are separate user-agents, so each can get its own rule.

es.alt: Ejecución real, tarjeta mundial. Al Jazeera marca texto para voz y bloquea la IA. Puntuación general: 84 de 100. SEO 89, GEO 64, Analítica 92, Seguridad 77, A11y 89, Velocidad 97. www.aljazeera.com, 20 páginas analizadas, 19 oct. 2026.
es.linkedin:

Su JSON-LD nombra una NewsMediaOrganization y marca texto speakable para asistentes de voz. Aun así, robots.txt prohíbe a ChatGPT-User y PerplexityBot, que abren las páginas para citarlas en respuestas de IA. GEO: 64.

La lección para cualquier equipo: Decide rastreador por rastreador. Los bots de entrenamiento y los de respuestas son user-agents distintos, así que cada uno puede tener su propia regla.

18-harvard.linkedin:
Any site can frame Harvard's pages.

Organization JSON-LD, a sitemap index, and Core Web Vitals that pass for real visitors. But the pages analyzed send neither X-Frame-Options nor frame-ancestors, so another site could load them in a hidden frame.

The lesson for every team: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self'. It blocks clickjacking and replaces X-Frame-Options.

es.linkedin:

An llms.txt for AI tools, security.txt, preloaded HSTS, and two sitemaps. But 19 of the 20 pages analyzed share one meta description, the home page's, so Learn and About pitch the same line in search.

The lesson for every team: Write a description per page that says what that page answers. A shared one tells search nothing new.

21-kubernetes.title: 13 Kubernetes pages share one title.
21-kubernetes.alt: Real run, worldwide card. 13 Kubernetes pages share one title. Overall score 80 of 100. SEO 67, GEO 88, Analytics 85, Security 67, A11y 86, Speed 91. kubernetes.io, 20 pages analyzed, 19 Oct 2026.
21-kubernetes.linkedin:
13 Kubernetes pages share one title.

A content security policy in report-only mode, nosniff, framing limited to its origin, and a sitemap. But no page analyzed sends Strict-Transport-Security, so browsers don't upgrade a first http visit.

46-ubuntu.linkedin:
Ubuntu speaks Markdown and names its nginx.

robots.txt points AI crawlers to Markdown versions of pages, port 80 is closed, and the CSP starts at default-src 'self'. But the Server header reads nginx/1.14.0 (Ubuntu), naming an exact version.

The lesson for every team: Turn off version tokens (server_tokens off in nginx). Exact versions make it easy to match known flaws.

nosniff, framing limited to its origin, a sitemap, and a 301 from http to https. But 17 pages configure two GA4 properties, G-R2FPS06ZSD and G-N4639JFT8D, so numbers split unless both teams know.

68-uniandes.linkedin:
Uniandes skips a link in its TLS chain.

HSTS, a CSP from default-src 'self', nosniff, and a Permissions-Policy. But the server sends its certificate twice and leaves out the DigiCert intermediate. Browsers patch it in; Node.js and API clients refuse.

The lesson for every team: Serve the full chain: leaf plus intermediates. Test with openssl s_client or SSL Labs after every renewal.

HSTS, a strict Referrer-Policy, and a sitemap in robots.txt. But CSP frame-ancestors allows *.windows.net and *.core.windows.net, hosts any Azure customer can publish on, so any of them could embed its pages.

73-rtvc.linkedin:
RTVC's search box has no label.

HSTS, a CSP from default-src 'self', nosniff, and a Permissions-Policy that turns off camera, mic, and location. But the search field relies on a placeholder, "Buscar", with no label to announce.

The lesson for every team: Add a <label> or aria-label to every input. Placeholders vanish while typing and aren't reliably announced.

86-biblored.linkedin:
BibloRed answers plain http with a 200.

Two-year HSTS marked for preload, nosniff, framing limited to its origin, and a canonical. But http://www.biblored.gov.co/ serves the page with a 200 instead of redirecting, and browsers ignore HSTS sent over http.

The lesson for every team: Redirect every http request to https with a 301. HSTS only counts when it arrives over https.

fr.linkedin:

HSTS sur deux ans marqué pour preload, nosniff, l’intégration en iframe limitée à son origine et un canonical. Mais http://www.biblored.gov.co/ sert la page avec un 200 au lieu de rediriger, et les navigateurs ignorent le HSTS envoyé en http.

La leçon pour chaque équipe : Redirigez chaque requête http vers https avec un 301. HSTS ne compte que s’il arrive en https.

89-planetario.linkedin:
The Planetarium skips a link in its TLS chain.

nosniff, framing limited to its origin, a declared language, and a 301 from http to https. But the server leaves out the Sectigo intermediate certificate. Browsers patch it in; Node.js and API clients refuse.

The lesson for every team: Install the full chain your certificate authority provides, then test with openssl s_client or SSL Labs.

91-medellin.alt: Real run, local card. Medellín's portal sends no HSTS. Overall score 74 of 100. SEO 89, GEO 91, Analytics 71, Security 54, A11y 65, Speed 80. www.medellin.gov.co, 19 pages analyzed, 19 Oct 2026. Lesson: Send HSTS with a one-year max-age once every subdomain serves https.
91-medellin.linkedin:
Medellín's portal sends no HSTS.

103-manizales.linkedin:
Manizales' visitors wait 5.7 s to see it.

A declared language, a canonical, a sitemap named in robots.txt, and a 301 to https. But real Chrome visitors wait 5.7 s at the 75th percentile for the largest content, and the HTML alone took 2.5 s.

The lesson for every team: Start with the server: cache the HTML. Then preload the hero image and defer scripts that aren't needed.
